items.title_en: BCI With Virtual Reality for Stroke Rehabilitation: A Crossover Study
bullets_zh: ClinicalTrials.gov研究NCT07374276评估运动想象BCI结合虚拟现实用于卒中康复。
该交叉设计检验在运动观察中加入MI-BCI是否能改善卒中后手臂和手部恢复。
它体现了基于EEG的非侵入式BCI在神经康复中的临床应用价值。
bullets_en: ClinicalTrials.gov study NCT07374276 evaluates motor imagery BCI combined with virtual reality for stroke rehabilitation.
The crossover design tests whether adding MI-BCI to motor observation improves arm and hand recovery after stroke.
It is relevant as a non-invasive clinical application of EEG-based BCI in neurorehabilitation.
items.brief: 非侵入式运动想象BCI联合VR的卒中上肢康复临床试验。
items.brief_en: Clinical trial testing non-invasive motor-imagery BCI with VR for arm-hand recovery after stroke.
items.raw_excerpt: The goal of this clinical trial is to investigate if training sessions of motor imagery associated with brain-computer interface and motor observation through virtual reality (MI-VR-BCI) can help to improve arm and hand recovery after a stroke. The main questions to answer are: * Can adding MI-BCI-VR sessions improve upper limb movement? * Can it help stroke survivors perform daily activities more
